title: Conform-Edge Clause Map Pack
description: A versioned, signed content pack of intent-based audit items for one standard or regulation. Contains Conform-Edge authored content only. Requirement text from copyrighted standards is never a field in this schema.

packId.description: Stable identifier, e.g. as9100d, iso9001-2015, faa-part145

designation.description: Descriptive designation of the external document, e.g. AS9100D, 14 CFR Part 145

revision.description: Edition or revision identifier, e.g. 2016, Rev D, current eCFR

publicDomain.description: True only for public law such as US federal regulations. Controls whether requirementText is permitted on items.

externalDocumentNotice.description: Notice that the user must hold their own licensed copy of the referenced standard.

groups.description: Conform-Edge authored grouping labels. Not the standard's table of contents.

applicability.description: All listed conditions must hold (AND). Within a condition, any listed value matches (OR). Absent = always applies.

clauseRef.description: Clause or section number only. A fact, not protected content.

label.description: Conform-Edge short label. Must not reproduce the source heading verbatim.

intent.description: What outcome the requirement intends, in Conform-Edge language.

question.description: The audit question the auditor asks to test intent.

ncPattern.description: What a typical failure looks like in practice.

findingStem.description: Opening of a nonconformity statement. Uses {evidence} placeholder. Cites clause and intent, never requirement text.

quotedFragment.description: Optional. A minimal operative fragment, a few words, where the exact term changes meaning. Validator enforces a word budget and a per-pack ratio.

requirementText.description: Permitted ONLY when source.publicDomain is true (public law). Validator rejects otherwise.
